designSystemScope: Separate Figma design-system board for a home decor ecommerce homepage template with room commerce, category discovery, product grids, trust proof, cart-ready product cards, editorial modules, and placeholder guidance.
components: product card with price and cart cue

states.hover: deep moss hover state for shopping confidence
states.active: sage active state for selected room or category

componentAnatomy.card: product image placeholder, title, material or room tag, price, cart cue
componentAnatomy.navigation: brand, room links, collection links, shop CTA
componentAnatomy.header: editable ecommerce nav with curated shop action
componentAnatomy.footer: brand, shop links, support links, source notes
componentAnatomy.placeholder: room, product, material, customer, and editorial image clues
componentAnatomy.cart: cart cue appears inside product card and product discovery grid
componentAnatomy.category: category ribbon and room browsing modules
componentAnatomy.trust: material proof, maker story, warranty and customer gallery modules

usageRules: Use warm surfaces and sage accents to make ecommerce feel tactile instead of generic.
Keep product, category, cart, and trust cues visible across the shopping flow.
Use editorial modules to explain materials and rooms before the product grid.

surfaceEffectTokens.cardShadow: warm soft shadow for product shelves
surfaceEffectTokens.heroDepth: rounded lifestyle board with warm shadow

placeholderRules: Use image placeholder: [purpose] for room scenes, product photos, material details, customer rooms, and editorial images.
Keep source imagery editable and replaceable by buyers.
Do not use final generated room photography unless explicitly requested.
